description: No new inline ESLint disable directive or inline rule configuration anywhere in bin/, mcp/, hooks/, tests/ or scripts/. A chokepoint that fires is fixed by restructuring the code (usually a bin/lib helper), never silenced; a test that must redirect data dirs through env vars gets a narrowly scoped exemption block in eslint.config.js. The baseline lists the directives that predate this rule (all of them no-explicit-any / no-unused-vars); each baseline entry equals that file's current count (removing a directive shrinks the baseline in the same change), and every other file has none.
